node.title: Re: Need an assistance on this scenario
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Sorry, but I fail to see how this is an emergency. [https://xkcd.com/208/|This is an emergency.]

But seriously: If you need help fast, the best way to get that is to help us help you. Read [id://174051], [id://510718], and provide a [id://1177642] that demonstrates the issue you're having. Just from your description, it sounds like you want to store the job state between runs of the script and only report on the state when it changes. Perhaps in a database?
